description: Config file parser cases from the configuration-file specification (File Loading, Critical Failure Cases, Comment Behavior, Whitespace Behavior, Property Behavior), transcribed from the specification text and the configuration-file cases as ported in aws-sdk-java-v2 ProfileFileTest.

tests.name: Empty files have no profiles.
Empty profiles have no properties.
Profile definitions must end with brackets.

output.errorContaining: Section definition must end with ']' on line 1

tests.name: Profile definitions must not have text after the closing bracket.
SSO session definitions must end with brackets.

input.configFile:
[profile profile1]
sso_session = sso-token1
[sso-session sso-token1
start_url = startUrl1

output.errorContaining: Section definition must end with ']' on line 3

tests.name: Profile names should be trimmed.
Tabs can separate profile names from profile prefix.
Whitespace is permitted around the profile prefix and name.
Properties must be defined in a profile.

output.errorContaining: Expected a profile definition on line 1

tests.name: Profiles can contain properties.
Windows style line endings are supported.
Equals signs are supported in property values.
Unicode characters are supported in property values.
Profiles can contain multiple properties.
Property keys and values are trimmed.
Property values can use minimal spacing.
Property values can be empty.
Property key cannot be empty.

output.errorContaining: Property did not have a name on line 2

tests.name: Property definitions must contain an equals sign.

output.errorContaining: Expected an '=' sign defining a property on line 2

tests.name: Multiple profiles can be empty.
Multiple profiles can have properties.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
name = value
[profile bar]
name2 = value2

tests.name: Blank lines are ignored.
Pound sign comments are ignored.

input.configFile:
# Comment
[profile foo] # Comment
name = value # Comment with # sign

tests.name: Semicolon sign comments are ignored.

input.configFile:
; Comment
[profile foo] ; Comment
name = value ; Comment with ; sign

tests.name: All comment types can be used together.

input.configFile:
# Comment
[profile foo] ; Comment
name = value # Comment with ; sign

tests.name: Comments can be empty.
Comments can be adjacent to profile names.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]; Adjacent semicolons
[profile bar]# Adjacent pound signs

tests.name: Comments adjacent to values are included in the value.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
name = value; Adjacent semicolons
name2 = value# Adjacent pound signs

tests.name: Tab-separated comments are removed from values.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
name = value	# Comment
name2 = value2	; Comment

tests.name: Property values can be continued on the next line.
Property values can be continued with multiple lines.
Continuations are trimmed.
Continuation values include pound comments.
Continuation values include semicolon comments.
Blank lines are permitted between continuations.
Continuations cannot be used outside of a profile.

output.errorContaining: Expected a profile or property definition on line 1

tests.name: Continuations cannot be used outside of a property.

output.errorContaining: Expected a profile or property definition on line 2

tests.name: Continuations reset with profile definitions.

output.errorContaining: Expected a profile or property definition on line 4

tests.name: Continuations reset with profile definitions separated by blank lines.

output.errorContaining: Expected a profile or property definition on line 5

tests.name: Properties can have sub-properties.
Invalid sub-properties cause an error.

output.errorContaining: Expected an '=' sign defining a property on line 3

tests.name: Sub-properties can have empty values.
Sub-properties cannot have empty names.

output.errorContaining: Property did not have a name on line 3

tests.name: Sub-properties with invalid names are left out of the sub-property map.
Sub-properties can have blank lines.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
s3 =
 name = value
	 
 name2 = value2

tests.name: Sub-property comments are part of the value.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
s3 =
 max_concurrent_requests = 30 ; Failed Comment Attempt

tests.name: Sub-properties can use extra whitespace.
Sub-properties can use minimal spacing.
A property line ends a sub-property section.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
s3 =
 max_concurrent_requests = 30
 max_retries = 10
region = us-west-2

tests.name: A section can contain multiple sub-property sections.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
s3 =
 max_concurrent_requests = 30
dynamodb =
 endpoint_url = https://localhost:1234

tests.name: Duplicate sub-properties use the later value.

input.configFile:
[profile foo]
s3 =
 name = value
 name = value2
